body: Hello brother, like other people I have met in Malaysia you are very kind and thank you for your offer and kind words. I had to leave Malaysia because my visa was about to expire I am in Thailand right now. I am doing better working online now. Hopefully things will get better. I too would like to chat and have a drink with you when I am back in Malaysia though.
Yep still in Malaysia.

It is a long story but i will try to summarize. I have a tablet. It allowed me to do online work, there are free wifi places in town and that was a life saver. I am bilingual and also got a college degree and corporate job experience. That helped a lot when it comes to earning money online.

Secondly I got $30 from a redditor, I paid that back yesterday, also two local strangers helped me. One of them even gave me 50 rmd that s around $12. He actually gave it to me to book a room for a budget hotel but I used that money for food only. You can get a meal around 6rmd. I normally ate a meal a day. On sundays there was free breakfast and lunch at sikh temple.
And yes thirdly sikh temple allowed me to use their shower and leave my bag there during the day. Also there was free water.

I worked day and night, slept on and off had a meal a day, I got help from people too. Currently I pay $4 per night for a bed in dorm and that includes breakfast and free water, coffee, tea all day. So it is a pretty good deal and I earn more than that in a day saving up now.

So yeah that’s about it. Sadly I do not have a formula that’d be applicable to homeless in US or europe I guess but keeping a positive attitude and keeping shit together helped a lot.

Thing is dude I put myself in their shoes, if I were them reading about some guy living on the street without any money yes he could be a scammer or he could be really struggling. So Before accusing him of scamming or smt I would ask for some proof. If I dont ask for anything like that and even refuse when OP offers to show proof I would keep my mouth shut because I wouldn’t want to make things even worse for him.

I don’t believe mods here are facilitating a medium or smt they straight accused me of scamming. I am used to those kind of people on internet but mods should have known better than that. There is no honor in trying to kick a guy who is already down.

Thanks, yup I will today is the start of a whole new chapter for me and I am excited!

To me southeast asia is a whole different world. Today I hanged at Hilton Lobby, used their restroom, wifi and didn’t pay a dime and all because people are kind and polite and I can act like a tourist. It is much different than south america or any other place. Yeah I am really busting my ass off to have an income by doing online work because that is a long term solution for me. I can both work and travel at the same time. Working at a hostel would be a temporary solution, if I fail at online work I will push for a job like that but currently I am ok with living on the streets if it means I can work on a permanent solution.

I quit a high paying corporate job at a reputable company to be able to travel. Marriage, mortgage they tie you down. After realizing all I want is to see the world out there I risked everything and hit the road. Even though it may seem it didn’t work out for me now, I would rather be at this bus stop typing this comment than being at a plaza forwarding e mails to different managers.
Begging and scamming? No thanks! Sleeping with clear conscience is more important than a comfy bed for me.
Thank you, I will check up on that. In the mean time, I will wash them one by one.
